==English==

===Etymology===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*per-|id=fare}}
From {{inh|en|enm|experience}}, from {{der|en|fro|-}}, from {{der|en|la|experientia||a trial, proof, experiment, experimental knowledge, experience}}, from {{m|la|experiens}}, present participle of {{m|la|experiri||to try, put to the test, undertake, undergo}}, from {{m|la|ex||out}} + {{m|la|peritus||experienced, expert}}, past participle of {{m|la||*periri|to go through}}; see {{m|en|expert}} and {{m|en|peril}}. Displaced native {{ncog|ang|āfandung||experience}} and {{m|ang|āfandian||to experience}}.

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# The effect upon the [[judgment]] or [[feeling]]s produced by any [[event]], whether [[witness]]ed or [[participate]]d in; [[personal]] and [[direct]] impressions as contrasted with [[description]] or fancies; personal [[acquaintance]]; actual [[enjoyment]] or [[suffering]].
#: {{ux|en|It was an '''experience''' he would not soon forget.}}
#* '''March 20, 1684-5''', {{w|John Sharp}}, ''Sermon preached at Whitehall''
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1913|author=[[w:Robert Barr (writer)|Robert Barr]]| title=Lord Stranleigh Abroad| chapter=4| url=http://openlibrary.org/works/OL1796924W| passage=“I have tried, as I hinted, to enlist the co-operation of other capitalists, but '''experience''' has taught me that any appeal is futile that does not impinge directly upon cupidity. {{...}}”}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=1957 July|author=M. D. Greville|title=A Diamond Jubilee of Railway Memories|journal=Railway Magazine|page=459|text=Lastly, I must mention the "Underground," to travel on which was, in those days, an '''experience''' to be remembered. There were the antique looking engines, and the rather grim carriages, with the fascinating indicators in the compartments to show (not always correctly!) the next station, and above all, there was the atmosphere.}}
# {{lb|en|countable}} An [[activity]] one has [[perform]]ed.
# {{lb|en|usually|uncountable}} A [[collection]] of [[event]]s and/or [[activity|activities]] from which an individual or group may gather [[knowledge]], [[opinion]]s, and [[skill]]s.
#: {{ux|en|Virtually all employers now require jobseekers to have work '''experience''' even for entry-level roles. Many believe this will hurt companies in the long run.}}
#* {{RQ:Livy Holland Romane Historie|year=1659|passage=they knew soone by '''experience''' how slenderly guarded against danger, the majestie of Rulers is}}
#* {{RQ:Locke Human Understanding|2|1|text=Whence has it all the materials of reason and knowledge? To this I answer in one word, from '''experience'''.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2024|author=NTSB| title=Intersection Crash Between Passenger Car and Combination Vehicle, Tishomingo, Oklahoma, March 22, 2022
   | passage= We determined that the car driver’s transportation of multiple teen passengers, limited driving '''experience''', and likely impairment from effects of cannabis at the time of the crash adversely affected her judgment of the danger of entering the intersection in front of the approaching combination vehicle.}}
# {{lb|en|uncountable}} The knowledge thus gathered.
# {{lb|en|corporate}} A [[business]] [[offering]] in which a [[major]] [[focus]] is the way that the [[customer]] [[interact]]s with the [[business]] throughout the [[transaction]], as opposed to only its [[outcome]] (the [[product]] or [[service]]).
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1999|title=Journal of Integrated Communications
|text=CDNOW's custom music selection and Levi Strauss & Co.'s custom-fit jean service are also good examples of giving customers more than just the product, but an '''experience''' as well.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|date=2008-01-01|author=Jon Sundbo|author2=Per Darmer|title=Creating Experiences in the Experience Economy|publisher=Edward Elgar Publishing|isbn=9781848444003|page=176
|text=Therefore, this chapter argues for an engagement with the actions, performances and practices of the experiencing subjects that 'make places' in the '''experience''' economy.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|date=2020-08-21|author=Susanne Doppler|author2=Adrienne Steffen|title=Case Studies on Food Experiences in Marketing, Retail, and Events|publisher=Woodhead Publishing|isbn=9780128177938|page=192
|text=In addition, technical developments will change the way firms offer '''experiences'''. Many firms will have to change their core product, offer a total '''experience''', and redesign their business processes.}}
# {{lb|en|gaming|originally|RPG}} {{synonym of|en|experience points}}
# {{lb|en|obsolete|uncountable}} Trial; a test or experiment.
#* {{RQ:Spenser Faerie Queene|book=V|canto=I|stanza=7|passage=She caused him to make '''experience''' / Vpon wyld beasts, which she in woods did find, / With wrongfull powre oppressing others of their kind}}
